meaning: Dependencies gate completion of the remaining work, not the existence of already implemented slices. Research-derived scope remains proposed until its spec and decisions are accepted.

conditionalDependencies.when: Review includes new 030 planning records; selected manuscript-only review does not require them.
An accepted future review slice uses routing policy; manual provider/model selection does not require routing.
Casting references new 030 character records; narrator-only generation does not require them.
